business.what: TCS is an IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization. It provides application development, digital transformation, AI, data, cloud, and engineering services to global enterprises, leveraging an AI-enabled operating model to deliver bespoke solutions and achieve differentiated business outcomes.
business.geography: Global footprint with 94.1% of turnover from exports. Key markets include North America (48.6%), UK (17.4%), Continental Europe (15.4%), and India (8.3%).

risks.risk: Geopolitical tensions and disruptions to energy markets and global trade flows.
Heightened macroeconomic uncertainty and enterprises exercising greater caution in discretionary spending.
Rapid emergence of deep-tech AI companies introducing new competitive dynamics for traditional services models.

claims.claim: The demand environment has not materially changed since last quarter, and discretionary programs without near-term value remain under scrutiny.
claims.quote: The demand environment has not materially changed since last quarter, and discretionary programs without near-term value remain under scrutiny.

claims.claim: The $3.1 billion AI revenues are coming in at a much higher margin than the company average.
claims.quote: the $3.1 billion AI revenues which we have are coming in at a much higher margin than our company average.

claims.claim: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of overall revenue.
claims.quote: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of our overall revenue.

claims.claim: The company expects furlough in Q3 to be very similar to previous years.
claims.quote: in Q3, so far from what we are seeing, the furlough will be very similar to the previous years.

claims.claim: Discretionary spending is under pressure, with project pauses, deferrals, and decision delays impacting revenue conversion.
claims.quote: We saw cost pressures in our customers causing previously unseen project pauses, deferrals and decision delays that resulted in less than expected revenue conversion.

claims.claim: Operating margins were impacted by carrying excess capacity due to a mismatch between built-up capacity and demand contraction.
claims.quote: The demand contraction during the quarter had an impact on our utilization and was offset by lower third-party costs and currency.

claims.claim: Pricing remains reasonably stable at an overall level.
claims.quote: Ankur, pricing has been reasonably stable at an overall level.

claims.claim: The company is not losing market share in North America.
claims.quote: I will not characterize it as losing any market share in North America. For starters, we are participating in almost all major engagements.

claims.claim: The company is seeing positive momentum across most industry verticals and new age services as it enters FY27.
claims.quote: most of the industry verticals, we see a positive momentum and our new age services are also gaining traction. So overall, we are getting into our next year with a lot of positivity and conﬁdence.

claims.claim: The company achieved a 25% operating margin for FY26, which is the highest in the last 4 years.
claims.quote: For FY26, our operating margin was 25%, an expansion of 70 basis points over the prior year, and at a 4-year high.

claims.claim: The company's annualized AI services revenue has surpassed $2.3 billion.
claims.quote: In Q4, our annualized AI revenues surpassed $2.3 billion, driven by the accelerated deployment of AI solutions across industries.

claims.claim: The company has completed its restructuring program.
claims.quote: The restructuring program that we started, we have completed that program. The program towards restructuring has been completed.

claims.claim: The company has not seen a broad-based caution from clients, with impacts limited to specific sectors like travel and transportation.
claims.quote: at this time, if you look at our direct impact from the geopolitical situation, so far has been restricted to Middle East and to some extent into our travel and transportation industry

claims.claim: The growth momentum we witnessed in Q2FY26 continued in this quarter.
claims.quote: The growth momentum we witnessed in Q2FY26 continued in this quarter.

claims.claim: Operating margin of 25.2% remained stable sequentially, excluding one-offs.
claims.quote: Our Q3 operating margins stood at 25.2%, remaining stable sequentially. This excludes one-oƯs.

claims.claim: AI services now generate US$1.8 billion in annualized revenue and is growing at 17.3% QoQ in constant currency.
claims.quote: Our AI services now generate US$1.8 billion in annualized revenue and is growing at 17.3% QoQ in constant currency.

claims.claim: Net cash from operations was US$1.6 billion, which is 130.4% of net income.
claims.quote: Net cash from operations was US$1.6 billion, which is 130.4% of net income.

claims.claim: The company released approximately 1,800 people in Q3 as part of restructuring.
claims.quote: in this quarter, we released approximately 1,800 people with all the due care and compliance to all the laws of the land.

claims.claim: TCS aims to become the world's largest AI-led tech services company.
claims.quote: This vision is a vision to be the world's largest AI- led tech services company.

claims.claim: TCS has achieved US$1.5 billion in annualized revenue from AI-related services.
claims.quote: Our AI-related services have garnered a total revenue of US$1.5 billion annualized.

claims.claim: TCS has trained 180,000 associates in higher-order AI skills.
claims.quote: And today, 180,000 TCSers possess higher-order AI skills.

claims.claim: TCS has completed more than 5,000 AI projects since 2023.
claims.quote: By now, we have done more than 5,000 projects.

claims.claim: Discretionary spending delays and project pauses intensified during the quarter, leading to lower-than-expected revenue conversion.
claims.quote: This trend has continued and intensified to some extent in this quarter. Global businesses were disrupted due to conflicts, economic uncertainties and supply chain issues.

claims.claim: Operating margins were impacted by carrying excess capacity relative to the demand contraction experienced during the quarter.
claims.quote: The demand contraction during the quarter had an impact on our utilization and was offset by lower third-party costs and currency.

claims.claim: Pricing remains stable at an overall level, with productivity demands usually addressed at the time of deal signing.
claims.quote: pricing has been reasonably stable at an overall level.

claims.quote: I will not characterize it as losing any market share in North America. For starters, we are participating in almost all major engagements.
